criteria.evidence: All 5 style.zoom sites in visual.spec.ts classified inline. Mission Reading (~L1919) and Work Explorer (~L2450): already honestly named 'CSS zoom stress' with no breakpoint of their own (no @media/@container in their stories.ts) -- left as-is. Repository Dossier (~L2151): has @container (max-width: 720px); measured empirically via a Playwright probe against the live story -- grid-template-columns='322px' identical between style.zoom='2' at 780px and a genuine halved 390px viewport at deviceScaleFactor:2, both diverging from the 780px-unzoomed baseline -- left as-is, correctly; reviewer independently re-derived this same result. Connectors (~L2975): initially fixed with the real halved-viewport+deviceScaleFactor:2 mechanism (matching FR-001), which CI then showed introduces a genuine CI-only render instability (688x1150 then 688x1165 device px within a single toHaveScreenshot stability loop, same element/page). Root-caused as far as possible without CI access: web-font swap ruled out BY SOURCE (no @font-face is ever applied to visible text -- --sk-font-sans/--sk-font-mono both resolve to pure system-font stacks, confirmed by grep), no other cause confirmed, local reproduction impossible (measured ~1224 vs CI's ~575-582 CSS-px rendering gap) -- full record in research.md. Resolved per #422's own second option: mechanism reverted to style.zoom, test renamed to 'Connectors 200% CSS zoom stress -- C8 project routing baseline, no document-level horizontal overflow', landing it in the same honestly-scoped state as Mission Reading/Work Explorer. Locally re-verified stable (3/3 runs, single-capture, no retry oscillation) after the revert.
